unchanged_record_reason: Source-reviewed v2 wording encodes byte-identically to the accepted canonical SC0 record.

blockers.reason: System instruction begins with an unmapped F2 preamble; its complete control semantics must be proven before fixed-dialogue encoding.
Four-byte non-prose fragment contains unmapped control bytes 03 and 0B.
Gold-award system message begins with an unmapped F2 preamble; it is not a proven Raphael story-dialogue record.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Still with me? Now let me explain the navigators--people like us.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio begins the deck-assignment tutorial.
records.source_meaning: Julio checks that Raphael understands and says he will explain navigators, meaning people like them.
records.localization_note: Still with me is a natural tutorial check-in; no authored breaks.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}An admiral assigns the crew.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio introduces crew assignments.
records.source_meaning: Julio says personnel management is one of an admiral's important jobs.
records.localization_note: Assigning the crew conveys personnel management in nautical language.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Give every navigator a post. Let's use the deck screen.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio explains the purpose of deck posts.
records.source_meaning: Julio says each navigator receives a duty for a comfortable voyage and that he will demonstrate on the deck.
records.localization_note: Deck screen makes the tutorial action clear without preserving Japanese line divisions.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}{MACRO:FI} is captain. A ship cannot sail or roam alone without one!{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio identifies the captain's post.
records.source_meaning: Julio says FI is captain and jokes that without a captain the ship cannot move or go somewhere by itself.
records.localization_note: The joke is localized conversationally and the name macro is preserved.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Sail handlers adjust sail angles. You need one per mast.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio explains sail-handler staffing.
records.source_meaning: Julio says sail handlers adjust sail angles for the wind and one is needed per mast.
records.localization_note: The concise wording preserves both the adjustment and staffing rule.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Helmsmen make the ship turn fast.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio explains the helmsman's role.
records.source_meaning: Julio says the helmsman becomes important when the ship must turn quickly.
records.localization_note: Uses familiar nautical terminology and natural instruction.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}A skilled helmsman can quickly maneuver the ship into a favorable position in battle.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio expands on the helmsman's combat value.
records.source_meaning: Julio says a capable helmsman can rapidly place the ship in a favorable battle position.
records.localization_note: Maneuver and favorable position preserve the tactical meaning.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Next is the adjutant. Though optional, one handles diplomacy and slows crew fatigue--an unsung hero.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio explains the adjutant's support functions.
records.source_meaning: Julio says an adjutant is optional but enables negotiations, reduces fatigue, and works behind the scenes.
records.localization_note: Unsung hero localizes the idiom about unseen support.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}A surveyor enables automatic travel and shows the fleet's coordinates. An important post.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio explains the surveyor's navigation functions.
records.source_meaning: Julio says a surveyor enables auto-movement and reveals fleet coordinates, making the job important.
records.localization_note: Uses the game's functional terminology in complete sentences.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}The lookout reports who ships serve and how nearby towns fare.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio explains the lookout's information role.
records.source_meaning: Julio says the lookout reports who other ships belong to and the state of towns while at sea.
records.localization_note: The wording keeps both faction ownership and town conditions clear.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Those posts are enough to sail. Experiment with the others yourself.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio concludes the deck-assignment explanation.
records.source_meaning: Julio says these posts are enough to launch normally and encourages further experimentation.
records.localization_note: Experiment conveys the invitation to research the remaining options.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Come on. You will see soon enough.{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio urges Raphael to follow him at the start of the route.
records.source_meaning: Claudio says to stop worrying and that Raphael will understand once he goes.
records.localization_note: Come on captures Claudio's breezy insistence.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Hey, {MACRO:FI}, what is a true sailor?{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: On the way to the docks, Claudio asks Raphael about sailors.
records.source_meaning: Claudio asks FI what he thinks of a man of the sea.
records.localization_note: True sailor conveys the romantic ideal without gender-heavy literal phrasing.

records.english: Hmm... What do you mean?{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael is puzzled by Claudio's broad question.
records.source_meaning: Raphael hesitates because he does not know how to answer what he thinks.
records.localization_note: Natural concise hesitation preserves his uncertainty.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Prince Henry and Duke Leon... Now those are real men!{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio cites famous seafarers with boyish admiration.
records.source_meaning: Claudio names Prince Henry and Duke Leon and gushes that they are cool.
records.localization_note: Real men matches his swaggering admiration without adding facts.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}The sea is every man's dream!{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio declares his romantic view of the sea.
records.source_meaning: Claudio says the sea is a man's great romance.
records.localization_note: Dream naturally conveys the idiomatic Japanese romantic ideal.

records.english: Here he goes...{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael reacts to Claudio's familiar speech.
records.source_meaning: Raphael remarks that Claudio has started up again.
records.localization_note: Idiomatic exasperation suited to close friends.

records.english: No ship, no voyage. What now?{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael points out the practical flaw in Claudio's dream.
records.source_meaning: Raphael asks how they can go to sea when they do not have a ship.
records.localization_note: The compact objection remains clear and skeptical.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}No romance! A man can dream!{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio complains that Raphael is spoiling his grand speech.
records.source_meaning: Claudio calls Raphael unromantic and says a man is trying to talk about his dreams.
records.localization_note: The compact retort retains Claudio's melodrama.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}We are here.{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio notices they have reached the docks.
records.source_meaning: Claudio says they have arrived.
records.localization_note: A brief natural arrival cue.

records.english: {SPEAKER:04}There you are...{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.context: Janus greets Raphael and Claudio at the dock.
records.source_meaning: Janus acknowledges that they have come.
records.localization_note: There you are fits Janus awaiting their arrival.

records.english: A ship...{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael sees the vessel waiting at the dock.
records.source_meaning: Raphael realizes that it is a ship.
records.localization_note: The pause is expressed with punctuation, not manual line breaks.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Surprised? She even has a name. Behold, the Carteira!{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio proudly presents their ship.
records.source_meaning: Claudio asks if Raphael is surprised and announces the ship's decided name, Carteira.
records.localization_note: Behold preserves Claudio's theatrical pride.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}She was scrap. Janus helped me repair her.{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio explains the Carteira's condition and repairs.
records.source_meaning: Claudio says they took in a derelict almost fit for scrap and that he and Janus repaired it.
records.localization_note: Practically scrap is vivid natural speech; both repairers remain credited.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Not yet... Someday, after we have more money.{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio admits their voyage cannot begin yet.
records.source_meaning: Claudio says it cannot happen immediately, but someday after they save money.
records.localization_note: More money naturally conveys what they need for their implied departure.

records.english: Let's go.{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael quietly resolves to make the voyage happen.
records.source_meaning: Raphael says they should go.
records.localization_note: Ellipsis preserves the deliberate, newly formed resolve.

records.english: {SPEAKER:04}What?{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.context: Janus reacts to Raphael's sudden declaration.
records.source_meaning: Janus gives a surprised what.
records.localization_note: Natural brief reaction.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Huh?{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio is equally surprised by Raphael's resolve.
records.source_meaning: Claudio reacts in surprise.
records.localization_note: Huh matches his casual voice.

records.english: You said it yourself, Claudio--we are going to sea! Julio might lend us the money!{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael embraces the plan and proposes asking Julio for financing.
records.source_meaning: Raphael reminds Claudio that he proposed going to sea and says old Julio may help with the money.
records.localization_note: Uses Julio's name rather than a potentially misleading literal old-man address.

records.english: Julio is my next stop--right now!{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael rushes off to ask Julio for help.
records.source_meaning: Raphael says he is going to Julio's place now.
records.localization_note: A natural, energetic declaration avoids an unsupported plural subject.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Hey! {MACRO:FI}!{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio calls after the departing Raphael.
records.source_meaning: Claudio shouts for FI.
records.localization_note: Preserves the runtime given-name macro.

records.english: Janus, Claudio, keep repairing her!{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael calls back instructions as he runs off.
records.source_meaning: Raphael asks Janus and Claudio to continue repairs and says he is relying on them.
records.localization_note: Retains his breathless enthusiasm and both names.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Hey! Wait, {MACRO:FI}!{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio shouts after Raphael.
records.source_meaning: Claudio tells FI to wait.
records.localization_note: Calls FI by the runtime name macro and preserves Claudio's urgency without adding an object absent from the source.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}He got more excited than anyone.{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio watches Raphael hurry away.
records.source_meaning: Claudio remarks that Raphael has become the most eager of them all.
records.localization_note: More excited than anyone is natural American speech for Raphael becoming the most enthusiastic.

records.english: {SPEAKER:04}Ha! Your habit rubbed off. Once decided, he cannot sit still.{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.context: Janus teases Claudio about influencing Raphael.
records.source_meaning: Janus laughs that Claudio's signature habit rubbed off on Raphael, who cannot stay still after deciding something.
records.localization_note: Favorite habit naturally conveys signature behavior.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}He was always like that. You rarely see it. How are repairs?{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio defends Raphael, then returns to the ship.
records.source_meaning: Claudio says Raphael was always that way despite appearances and asks about repairs.
records.localization_note: Smooths the topic shift with anyway.

records.english: {SPEAKER:04}Nearly done--most of it was my work.{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.context: Janus reports on repairs and dryly notes the workload.
records.source_meaning: Janus says repairs are mostly complete and he ended up doing almost everything.
records.localization_note: Preserves Janus's singular, understated complaint as one compact thought within allocation.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Do not sweat the details. You enjoyed every minute of it!{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio brushes off Janus's complaint.
records.source_meaning: Claudio tells Janus not to fuss because he was clearly enjoying himself.
records.localization_note: Do not sweat the details suits Claudio's casual teasing.

records.english: {SPEAKER:04}Ha, true enough. Shall we join Raphael at Julio's place?{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.context: Janus admits Claudio is right and suggests following Raphael.
records.source_meaning: Janus laughs, agrees, and proposes that they also go to Julio.
records.localization_note: Uses established names and a natural transition.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Yeah. {MACRO:FI} needs me beside him!{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio insists on staying with Raphael.
records.source_meaning: Claudio agrees and says he has to stay with FI.
records.localization_note: Needs me beside him captures Claudio's protective swagger and obligation to stay with Raphael.

records.english: {SPEAKER:04}Yes, yes. We know. Let us go.{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.context: Janus humors Claudio and gets him moving.
records.source_meaning: Janus says he understands and repeats that they should go.
records.localization_note: The repetition becomes dry, natural impatience.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}What?! Another advance, Claudio? Outrageous! What will you spend it on this time?{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio initially thinks Claudio is asking him for another loan.
records.source_meaning: Julio angrily accuses Claudio of seeking another advance and demands to know its purpose.
records.localization_note: Another advance preserves the history of Claudio borrowing against future earnings.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Do not shout at us, old man!{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio snaps back at Julio's immediate accusation.
records.source_meaning: Claudio tells Julio not to yell at him without warning and calls him an old man.
records.localization_note: Old man is safe here as an insult, not a claimed family relationship.

records.english: Sorry to impose.{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael politely apologizes before making his request.
records.source_meaning: Raphael apologizes for making an unreasonable request.
records.localization_note: Complete idiomatic apology avoids telegraphic phrasing.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Are you from the {MACRO:FA} family?{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio recognizes Raphael by his family.
records.source_meaning: Julio asks whether Raphael is the boy from FA's family.
records.localization_note: Castor boy uses the family-name macro's established identity without inventing kinship to Julio.

records.english: Pardon our intrusion.{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael apologizes for arriving with a sudden request.
records.source_meaning: Raphael apologizes for being abrupt or discourteous.
records.localization_note: Polite but natural wording suits Raphael's upbringing.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}This is different! We are serious this time, so quit being stingy and lend us the money!{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio argues that their voyage is not another frivolous scheme.
records.source_meaning: Claudio says this request differs from earlier ones, promises serious work, and bluntly demands a loan.
records.localization_note: Keeps his rude pressure while avoiding stilted literal syntax.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}You have never done an honest day's work. Asking me to trust you now is far too much.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio rejects Claudio's claim that he will work seriously.
records.source_meaning: Julio says he has never seen Claudio work properly and that demanding trust is naive.
records.localization_note: Honest day's work gives Julio's rebuke natural American force.

records.english: {SPEAKER:04}Your reputation precedes you...{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.context: Janus dryly explains why Julio distrusts Claudio.
records.source_meaning: Janus says this is entirely the result of Claudio's usual conduct.
records.localization_note: Caught up with you is a natural rendering of reputation having consequences.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Grr...{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio has no answer to Janus's observation.
records.source_meaning: Claudio growls in frustration.
records.localization_note: Retains the comic frustrated sound.

records.english: Please, Julio! This was my idea! Will you not reconsider?{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael takes responsibility and personally asks Julio for the loan.
records.source_meaning: Raphael pleads with Julio, says the plan was his idea, and asks if the answer must be no.
records.localization_note: Reconsider fits Raphael's earnest politeness.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Hmm. Even for you, {MACRO:FI}, that is a lot. What does your father say?{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio softens toward Raphael but asks whether his father approves.
records.source_meaning: Julio says the sum is large even for FI's request and asks what Raphael's father thinks.
records.localization_note: Keeps the father reference because the scene explicitly establishes it.

records.english: My father won't help. We'll repay you. Please!{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael explains why he refuses to seek family backing.
records.source_meaning: Raphael refuses to rely on his father, promises to repay Julio, and pleads for the loan.
records.localization_note: Keeps Raphael's refusal personal and the repayment promise collective.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Good. You seek independence. Still, resolve may not be enough.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio admires Raphael's independence but remains hesitant.
records.source_meaning: Julio is impressed that Raphael seeks independence but says he understands the resolve and still has doubts.
records.localization_note: Independence directly conveys hitoridachi without broadening it into abstract freedom.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Then never mind. Come on, {MACRO:FI}, Janus. We are leaving.{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio loses patience with Julio's hesitation and pulls the others away.
records.source_meaning: Claudio says he will stop asking and tells FI and Janus to leave with him.
records.localization_note: Preserves his abrupt temper and both addressees.

records.english: {SPEAKER:04}Yes, yes. Just stop pulling me.{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.context: Claudio physically drags Janus away.
records.source_meaning: Janus says he understands and asks Claudio not to pull him.
records.localization_note: Natural comic protest.

records.english: Sorry for the trouble. Goodbye.{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael politely takes leave after Julio refuses.
records.source_meaning: Raphael apologizes for the unreasonable request and says goodbye.
records.localization_note: Formal courtesy contrasts naturally with Claudio's exit.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}So much for that... What now?{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Outside Julio's home, Claudio confronts their lack of funds.
records.source_meaning: Claudio sighs that despite his bold words, he does not know what to do.
records.localization_note: So much for that naturally conveys Claudio's rueful retreat from his earlier bravado.

records.english: {SPEAKER:04}{MACRO:FI}, why not ask your father?{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.context: Janus asks why Raphael will not seek his father's help.
records.source_meaning: Janus asks FI why he does not make the request of his father.
records.localization_note: Direct natural question; explicit father relationship is source-established.

records.english: My father treats me like a child. He'd never let me sail.{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael explains his conflict with his father.
records.source_meaning: Raphael says his father always treats him as a child and would certainly oppose him boarding a ship.
records.localization_note: The two natural sentences preserve both his father's attitude and practical objection.

records.english: Unless we act right now, nothing will change!{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael insists this is his chance to become independent.
records.source_meaning: Raphael says nothing will change if he does not do something here and now.
records.localization_note: Preserves the source's cause-and-effect statement in forceful, natural English.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}That's the spirit, {MACRO:FI}! That's how a man should be!{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio loudly endorses Raphael's independence.
records.source_meaning: Claudio praises FI's resolve and says that is how a man ought to be.
records.localization_note: That's the spirit preserves Claudio's emphatic approval without inventing a command or nautical metaphor.

records.english: {SPEAKER:04}A noble sentiment, but spirit alone will not pay our expenses.{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.context: Janus brings Claudio and Raphael back to the financial problem.
records.source_meaning: Janus says their masculine spirit is fine but they still lack the necessary money.
records.localization_note: Noble sentiment preserves his dry politeness while avoiding literal gender repetition.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Do not ruin the moment... Guess we have to earn it the slow way.{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio concedes that they may need to work steadily for the money.
records.source_meaning: Claudio tells Janus not to say that and sighs that they may have to proceed patiently.
records.localization_note: Earn it the slow way makes the implied financial plan explicit.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Wait!{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio calls the group back before they leave.
records.source_meaning: Julio calls out to them from a distance.
records.localization_note: Wait conveys the scene function naturally.

records.english: Julio? What does he want?{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael notices Julio coming after them.
records.source_meaning: Raphael recognizes Julio and wonders what is happening.
records.localization_note: Natural reaction using the established name.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Still here? Good, good.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio catches the group before they depart.
records.source_meaning: Julio is relieved that they have not left yet.
records.localization_note: Keeps his repeated, grandfatherly cadence without implying kinship.

records.english: {SPEAKER:04}What is it?{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.context: Janus asks why Julio called them back.
records.source_meaning: Janus asks what Julio wants.
records.localization_note: Natural concise question.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}After some thought...{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio begins explaining his change of heart.
records.source_meaning: Julio says he has considered the matter carefully.
records.localization_note: Preserves the suspenseful hesitation with punctuation.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Spit it out already, old man!{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio impatiently interrupts Julio.
records.source_meaning: Claudio says Julio is frustratingly slow and demands that he speak.
records.localization_note: Old man is Claudio's established insult, not a family claim.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Very well... {MACRO:FI}, take this.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio offers Raphael the money.
records.source_meaning: Julio decides and tells FI to accept what he is handing over.
records.localization_note: Direct, suspenseful handoff; macro preserved.

records.english: What?! This...!{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael recognizes the large sum Julio has offered.
records.source_meaning: Raphael exclaims in shock upon seeing the gift.
records.localization_note: Natural startled fragment retains the interruption.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}This is a loan. You will repay it properly, with interest.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio makes clear that the money must be repaid.
records.source_meaning: Julio says that since he handed it over, he expects repayment with interest.
records.localization_note: States the loan condition plainly in American English.

records.english: Y-yes! We will work hard!{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael gratefully accepts Julio's terms.
records.source_meaning: Raphael stammers yes and promises to do his best.
records.localization_note: Preserves his overwhelmed enthusiasm.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}That is much of my money. We will watch where it goes.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio hints that he will supervise the expedition.
records.source_meaning: Julio worries about the fate of his funds and decides they need watching.
records.localization_note: Sets up the reveal without awkward literal phrasing.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}We mean to sail with you. Understand?{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio reveals that he intends to join the crew.
records.source_meaning: Julio asks if they understand and says he too will board the ship.
records.localization_note: We reflects the source's self-referential old-fashioned pronoun without inventing companions.

records.english: Really?!{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael reacts with delight to Julio joining.
records.source_meaning: Raphael asks in surprise whether it is true.
records.localization_note: Natural enthusiastic reaction.

records.english: {SPEAKER:04}A veteran navigator aboard? We feel safer already.{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.context: Janus welcomes Julio's experience.
records.source_meaning: Janus says it is reassuring that a veteran navigator will sail with them.
records.localization_note: Expresses Janus's polite reassurance naturally.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Veteran? Been a while, but you flatter me.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio modestly accepts the compliment and admits he is rusty.
records.source_meaning: Julio is embarrassed to be called a veteran and notes that he has been away from sailing for a while.
records.localization_note: Balances Julio's admission and pleased embarrassment without unsafe literal macro bytes.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Will this old man be any use?{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio doubts Julio's current ability.
records.source_meaning: Claudio wonders whether Julio can actually still be useful.
records.localization_note: Keeps Claudio's rude teasing without inventing kinship.

records.english: {SPEAKER:04}Show respect. Julio is a famous navigator.{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.context: Janus rebukes Claudio and defends Julio's reputation.
records.source_meaning: Janus tells Claudio to stop being rude and says Julio is famous as a navigator.
records.localization_note: Show respect suits Janus's corrective role.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}{MACRO:FI}, you will be captain.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio appoints Raphael captain of the Carteira.
records.source_meaning: Julio tells FI that he will serve as captain.
records.localization_note: Formal appointment; macro preserved.

records.english: Me?! Janus and Claudio built it.{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael protests that the others have a stronger claim to command.
records.source_meaning: Raphael is surprised because Janus and Claudio are the ones connected with the ship.
records.localization_note: Built makes the basis of his objection clear from the preceding scene.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}The {MACRO:FO} is trusting {MACRO:FI} {MACRO:FA} to lead. You bear responsibility for this loan.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio ties the loan to Raphael's new responsibility as company leader.
records.source_meaning: Julio says he lends on trust in FI FA as leader of FO, making Raphael the responsible party.
records.localization_note: All runtime identity macros are preserved in source order.

records.english: Head of the {MACRO:FO}?! But...{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael is overwhelmed by the title Julio has assigned him.
records.source_meaning: Raphael reacts in shock to FO and to being called its leader.
records.localization_note: Company clarifies the organization naturally; macro preserved.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}You mean to make your name on seas ruled by the world's greatest sailors, do you not? Then show some ambition!{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio challenges Raphael to accept the stature his voyage demands.
records.source_meaning: Julio says Raphael plans to earn fame among renowned navigators worldwide and therefore needs that much resolve.
records.localization_note: Show some ambition condenses the exhortation without diminishing its meaning.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}So {MACRO:FI} {MACRO:FA} will captain this ship, command the fleet, and lead the {MACRO:FO}.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio formally defines Raphael's three roles.
records.source_meaning: Julio says FI FA is captain of the ship, admiral of the fleet, and leader of FO.
records.localization_note: Parallel structure clearly presents the three responsibilities; macros preserved.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Put Claudio in charge? One failure, and he works for free forever...{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio jokingly offers Claudio the dangerous responsibility instead.
records.source_meaning: Julio asks whether Claudio should be leader and warns that a failure would leave him working without pay forever.
records.localization_note: Keeps Julio's rhetorical alternative and the threatened consequence clear.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Still fine with that?{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio presses Claudio with the consequences of taking charge.
records.source_meaning: Julio asks whether Claudio still finds the arrangement acceptable.
records.localization_note: Natural, pointed follow-up.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}N-no! {MACRO:FI} leads. Right, Janus?{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio immediately pushes leadership back onto Raphael.
records.source_meaning: Claudio panics, says FI must be leader, and seeks Janus's agreement.
records.localization_note: Keeps the stammer and comic reversal; macro preserved.

records.english: {SPEAKER:04}Agreed. Leadership is not for me.{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.context: Janus calmly declines the role as well.
records.source_meaning: Janus agrees and says he is not the sort to be a leader.
records.localization_note: Keeps Janus modest and restores the singular self-reference.

records.english: But...{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael still hesitates to accept command.
records.source_meaning: Raphael begins another objection.
records.localization_note: Punctuation preserves the interrupted hesitation.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Just give it your best.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio reassures Raphael that effort is enough.
records.source_meaning: Julio says it will be fine if Raphael works hard.
records.localization_note: Supportive natural reassurance.

records.english: All right. We will do it!{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael accepts command and the venture.
records.source_meaning: Raphael says he understands and will try.
records.localization_note: We will do it gives the acceptance confident momentum.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Good. Use that money as your starting capital.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio explains how Raphael should use the loan.
records.source_meaning: Julio is reassured and tells Raphael to use the money as initial operating funds.
records.localization_note: Starting capital is accurate business terminology.

records.english: Thank you! We will use it wisely!{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael gratefully promises to safeguard the money.
records.source_meaning: Raphael thanks Julio and promises to use the funds carefully.
records.localization_note: Use it wisely is idiomatic and faithful.

records.english: {SPEAKER:04}We owe you a great deal, Julio.{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.context: Janus thanks Julio for all his assistance.
records.source_meaning: Janus says they are grateful for everything Julio has done.
records.localization_note: Uses Julio's name and natural restrained gratitude.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Not bad, old man. Not bad at all!{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio offers Julio a backhanded compliment.
records.source_meaning: Claudio says Julio has a surprisingly good side after all.
records.localization_note: Not bad preserves the teasing compliment.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Such arrogance, young pup!{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio takes offense at Claudio's patronizing praise.
records.source_meaning: Julio asks what the young upstart is saying so arrogantly.
records.localization_note: Archaic-flavored insult suits Julio without adding a rank or relationship.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}What, old fossil? We praised you!{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio turns the misunderstanding into an argument.
records.source_meaning: Claudio curses Julio and protests that he was offering praise.
records.localization_note: Old fossil localizes the insult without implying family.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}A little pain may teach you my greatness.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio threatens to discipline Claudio physically.
records.source_meaning: Julio says Claudio needs a painful lesson before he will understand Julio's greatness.
records.localization_note: Keeps Julio's comic grandiosity and restores his singular boast.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Want a fight?{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio eagerly accepts Julio's challenge.
records.source_meaning: Claudio asks whether Julio wants to fight.
records.localization_note: Natural taunt.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Heh! A pup like you cannot beat me!{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio boasts that Claudio cannot beat him.
records.source_meaning: Julio laughs and says he still will not lose to Claudio.
records.localization_note: Pup carries Julio's age-based contempt while preserving the one-on-one challenge.

records.english: Stop it, both of you!{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael tries to halt the brewing fight.
records.source_meaning: Raphael tells both men to stop.
records.localization_note: Direct natural command.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}No! This fool needs one good punch!{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio refuses to back down from Claudio.
records.source_meaning: Julio says he cannot rest until he strikes Claudio with his fist.
records.localization_note: One good punch preserves the comic specificity without turning Julio into a plural speaker.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Oh? Want your fingers broken?{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio counters with his own threat.
records.source_meaning: Claudio asks whether Julio wants the bones in his fingers broken.
records.localization_note: The compact threat remains natural and clear.

records.english: Enough! Captain's order: stop!{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael invokes his new authority for the first time.
records.source_meaning: Raphael exasperatedly gives a captain's order that they stop fighting.
records.localization_note: The command's object is explicit from the active fight.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Yes, Captain! Whatever you say!{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio instantly obeys Raphael with playful enthusiasm.
records.source_meaning: Claudio says he will comply because the captain said so.
records.localization_note: Playful military-style acknowledgment suits his sudden obedience.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}As the captain says!{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio echoes Claudio's obedience.
records.source_meaning: Julio says he will comply because the captain said so.
records.localization_note: Mirrors Claudio's wording to set up the imitation joke.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Hey! Do not copy me, old man!{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio accuses Julio of mimicking him.
records.source_meaning: Claudio complains that Julio copied him.
records.localization_note: Keeps the childish comic bickering and preserves Claudio's singular complaint.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Hmph. Copy you? Never.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio denies copying Claudio.
records.source_meaning: Julio scoffs that he would not imitate someone like Claudio.
records.localization_note: The compact rhetorical denial is haughty and avoids an unnatural plural self-reference.

records.english: {SPEAKER:04}What a pair...{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.context: Janus reacts wearily to Claudio and Julio.
records.source_meaning: Janus sighs at the situation.
records.localization_note: What a pair captures his dry exasperation.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Never mind the fool. Now that it is settled, let us gather everything needed for the voyage.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio ends the argument and begins voyage preparations.
records.source_meaning: Julio says to ignore the fool and, since the decision is made, prepare thoroughly by gathering voyage necessities.
records.localization_note: Localizes the preparation proverb by its practical meaning.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Hard work lies ahead. Stay close.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio warns Raphael that preparations will be demanding.
records.source_meaning: Julio says the process is difficult and tells Raphael to follow carefully.
records.localization_note: Natural tutorial instruction.

records.english: Yes! Please teach us!{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Raphael eagerly accepts Julio's guidance.
records.source_meaning: Raphael enthusiastically asks Julio to teach him.
records.localization_note: We avoids unsafe standalone uppercase first-person text while retaining intent.

records.english: {SPEAKER:05}Tch. He knows ships, so now he is {MACRO:FI}'s teacher?{PAD}
records.speaker: Claudio Manaus
records.context: Claudio resents Julio taking charge of Raphael's instruction.
records.source_meaning: Claudio grumbles that knowing a little about ships has made Julio act like FI's teacher.
records.localization_note: Keeps Claudio's jealousy and the runtime name macro.

records.english: {SPEAKER:04}Enough backtalk. Let us go.{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.context: Janus shuts down Claudio's complaint.
records.source_meaning: Janus tells Claudio to stop mouthing off and says they should leave.
records.localization_note: Backtalk naturally matches Janus's corrective tone.

records.english: {SPEAKER:04}Let us begin preparing to sail.{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.context: Janus formally starts the voyage-preparation phase.
records.source_meaning: Janus says they should begin the preparations needed for the voyage.
records.localization_note: Simple natural transition to the tutorial.

records.english: {SPEAKER:04}Will Julio show you the ropes, or will you prepare on your own?{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus Pasar
records.context: Janus presents the guided-tutorial choice.
records.source_meaning: Janus asks whether Raphael will learn preparations from Julio or prepare by himself.
records.localization_note: Show you the ropes is a natural nautical localization.

records.english: Learn.{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Player choice to accept Julio's tutorial.
records.source_meaning: The choice says to learn from Julio.
records.localization_note: Clear menu choice phrased as Raphael's decision.

records.english: We can do it.{PAD}
records.speaker: Raphael Castor
records.context: Player choice to skip Julio's tutorial.
records.source_meaning: The choice says Raphael can do it himself.
records.localization_note: Clear idiomatic menu choice; avoids unsafe standalone uppercase first-person glyph.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Very well. Visit the trading post.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio starts the guided preparation tutorial.
records.source_meaning: Julio agrees and says they should begin preparations by going to the trading post.
records.localization_note: Uses the project's standard location term and a natural tutorial imperative.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Before sailing, visit the trading post, tavern, and square.{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio gives a general pre-departure tutorial tip.
records.source_meaning: Julio says that in any town one should visit the trading post, tavern, and square before departure.
records.localization_note: Concise imperative reads naturally as game instruction.

records.english: {SPEAKER:06}Excellent! Good luck out there!{PAD}
records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Julio encourages Raphael after the independent-preparation choice.
records.source_meaning: Julio calls Raphael dependable and urges him to work hard.
records.localization_note: Warm natural encouragement closes the choice branch.
